# dgrid_from_atoms { #mofography.compute.dgrid_from_atoms }

`compute.dgrid_from_atoms(ase_atoms, radii=None, spacing=0.25, block_size=50000, n_neighbors=10, probe_radius=0)`

The function `dgrid_from_atoms` generates a distance grid over atoms using Dask arrays and computes
the grid based on atomic radii and specified parameters.

## Parameters

| Name           | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | Default    |
|----------------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| `ase_atoms`    |        | The `ase_atoms` parameter in the `dgrid_from_atoms` function is expected to be an ASE Atoms object, which represents a collection of atoms and their properties. This object typically contains information about the atomic positions, chemical symbols, and unit cell of a molecular system. You can create an                                                    | _required_ |
| `radii`        |        | The `radii` parameter in the `dgrid_from_atoms` function is used to specify the atomic radii for the atoms in the input `ase_atoms`. If the `radii` parameter is not provided by the user, a default set of van der Waals radii for different elements                                                                                                              | `None`     |
| `spacing`      |        | The `spacing` parameter in the `dgrid_from_atoms` function represents the distance between grid points in the mesh grid that is created over the atoms. It determines how finely the space is divided for computing the distance grid. A smaller spacing value will result in a denser grid with more grid points                                                   | `0.25`     |
| `block_size`   |        | The `block_size` parameter in the `dgrid_from_atoms` function is used to specify the size of each block when processing the grid points. This parameter determines how many grid points are processed at a time, which can impact memory usage and computational efficiency. Adjusting the `block_size` can, defaults to 50000 (optional)                           | `50000`    |
| `n_neighbors`  |        | The `n_neighbors` parameter in the `dgrid_from_atoms` function represents the number of nearest neighbors to consider when computing the distance grid for each point in the grid. This parameter determines how many neighboring atoms will influence the calculation of distances in the grid. Increasing the `n_neighbors` value will, defaults to 10 (optional) | `10`       |
| `probe_radius` |        | The `probe_radius` parameter in the `dgrid_from_atoms` function represents the radius of the probe used in the calculation. This parameter is used in the computation of the distance grid over atoms. The probe radius is typically used in molecular modeling and simulations to mimic the size of a solvent molecule or, defaults to 0 (optional)                | `0`        |

## Returns

| Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|--------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | The function `dgrid_from_atoms` returns a Dask array representing the distance grid computed over the input ASE atoms. The distance grid is computed based on the provided parameters such as radii, spacing, block size, number of neighbors, and probe radius. The function utilizes Dask for parallel computation and returns the distance grid reshaped to the correct shape specified by the input ASE atoms. |
